assets.historical_description: Untitled photograph, possibly related to loan companies on lower Douglas Street, Omaha, Nebraska. The catalog says the photograph is untitled and its precise relationship to another negative is uncertain.
assets.suggested_scene: Opening Omaha 1930s street collage; use as period context behind newly illustrated figures and props.
assets.limits: This is not a photograph of Warren Buffett, his family, his home, or a verified shop he visited. Do not label it as such. Credit and caption should preserve the uncertainty in the LOC catalog title.
